engineeringGuards: Immutable inputs/results; bounded checked arithmetic; negative/invalid inputs fail closed
Stable must retain its recorded deadline; never invent one
Ordinary zero-HP creature without death saves must already be Dead or legally Stable
Schema1 retains exact golden bytes; schema2 has exactly one active time representation
New work fixture cannot overwrite incompatible schema/content/TestOnly saves
256 work records per collection keep worst-case aggregate within1MiB; technical bound, not gameplay capacity
Schema3 bounds ledger collections at128, crop/plot/food records at8 and tasks per batch at32; technical session bounds, not gameplay capacities
Stored output/booking/care timestamps must be representable; hypothetical later deadlines are compared exactly before choosing the earliest target
Historical labor must match task worker and timestamps; physical harvest output is retained when edible freshness expires
Initial slots approved; later membership/calendar proposals remain unadopted
Quantity units are supplied by their record; no implicit conversion between pounds, Load, time or Extraction Class
Cross-unit fallback only for atomic source amounts; inclusive other-unit ambiguity stays unknown rather than hiding child values
Inclusive total lower-bound checks are conservative, not a general algebraic feasibility solver; partial overlap requiring decomposition rejects
Burden inputs capped at256 records and256 references per item; technical bounded helper only
Schema4 only uses ledger componentv2; schemas1-3 retainv1 and reject fractional/partial ledgers; no implicit migration or incompatible save overwrite
Physical stock exists only in WorkLedger; immutable descendant history conserves source initial amount across stock, consumption and immediate children
Host inventory-owner and recipient-consent grants are separate from payload; current grants precede duplicate receipt handling
Schema4 retains at most512 receipts,128 lots/claims/labor intervals,32 intakes,64 handling records and8 crops of32 tasks; technical fail-closed bounds, not game rules
Shared timeline credits intake to actual crop-stopped milestones before further advancing; finite ordinary handling processes its endpoint; no offline progress
One-entry tactical fixture has no clock/turn-reset command; first interaction and second Action cannot be replenished by repeated entry

The host verifies initial ration-bundle fit only; body carrying capacity cannot authorize unknown harvested-food pouch fit. Fixed pouch/skin fixtures are counted in burden but are not transferable physical-container records.

Schema5 supplies two stable carried skins, a supported ordinary flask, a finite32pint clean pool and explicit two-hand fixture capability. Separate vessel and liquid ownership must both authorize filling; active opening/work conflicts reject. Paused capacity/material claims remain. Historical records retain custody/access constraints; general topology and unsupported events are not silently simulated. Maximum schema5 structural records also extend the existing inventory_maximum_component_counts_fit_snapshot_codec case.

Schema6 is created explicitly by TestOnlyFillingPolicy(movableVessels:true). The fixture supplies closed safe handheld vessels, capable hand counts and supported plot placement. Movement history is bounded64 and ordered by committed command revision, including same-clock tactical events; no history eviction. Historical quantities are derived from original lots, descendant creation and actual intake. Historical actor positions and arbitrary access are not reconstructed. Max schema6 structural counts extend inventory_maximum_component_counts_fit_snapshot_codec.

TestOnlyEncounterPolicy creates schema7 explicitly; no production actors/effects/attacks enter this bounded profile. Resolved order is fingerprinted, not automatically sorted. Completed start history is bounded128; food/vessel records keep their existing64 bounds; no history eviction. Exact command receipt matching detects malformed history but is not authentication. Maximum schema7 structural counts roundtrip within1MiB. CurrentMovement exposes the paid Dash cap; actual movement execution is gated. All post-entry revisions must have contiguous command receipt coverage; deleting both an action and its receipt cannot create an unexplained revision gap.

At the478-case helper checkpoint, exact life timing adds no snapshot schema or migration: LifeState remains a detached immutable helper outside Snapshot. The new RuleTime APIs share existing life transitions; the old long-second APIs are adapters. Fractional legacy getter access fails explicitly. Rational representational overflow fails rather than rounding.

Schema8 is explicit and has no implicit migration. Its byte envelope is2MiB to fit tested structural maxima (1199243 bytes); schemas1-7 retain1MiB and unchanged encodings. Codec structure allows64 actors,20 levels each,32 held IDs each,256 life events; this policy requires exactly two numerical fixtures and empty held-item lists, admits at most128 regular starts and512 receipts. Counts are technical capacity bounds, not game rules. Replayed receipts prove internal consistency, not authorization or tamper resistance. Full command replay validates life/clock outcomes; general crop/world replay equivalence is not claimed.

CombatCell is an explicit five-foot-grid type; existing synthetic ActorState coordinates are not implicitly converted. NeighborPassesCornerRule is only a corner constraint, never permission to enter solid/occupied terrain. RangeResult reports range only; CoverResult.DirectTargetLegal reports cover only. Callers must combine actual perception, line-of-effect and all remaining attack prerequisites before spending or rolling.

PendingKnockout is currently an immutable in-memory procedure continuation, not a serialized command state. It never exposes a final damage outcome until completion. Calling Complete does not itself authorize the chooser, spend resources or mutate a global RNG; the upcoming host must persist its captured inputs/draw state, guard authority/idempotency and block other advancement. No schema change in this increment.
